news.headline: Bank of America cuts Caribou Biosciences price target to $5 from $6
news.summary: BofA Securities trimmed its price target on CRBU following the Q2 2026 results, while maintaining coverage. The cut reflects a more cautious read on financing risk for the vispa-cel pivotal program even as clinical data continued to impress.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences earnings beat estimates but revenue misses
news.summary: CRBU reported a Q2 2026 GAAP loss of $0.24/share, beating the -$0.32 consensus, while licensing revenue of $1.5M came in below the ~$2.3M estimate. Operating expenses fell year-over-year on the back of the 2025 workforce reduction and pipeline prioritization.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences reports Q2 2026 results: $113.8M cash, runway into end of 2027, deeper CB-011 myeloma data
news.summary: Cash, equivalents and marketable securities stood at $113.8M as of June 30, 2026, down from $142.8M at year-end but now guided to last into the end of 2027 (extended from the prior 2H 2027 guide) after further cost cuts. At the higher 450M-cell CB-011 dose in BCMA-naive myeloma patients, Caribou reported a 92% ORR, 83% CR/sCR rate and 91% MRD-negativity; vispa-cel data in 2L LBCL held at 82% ORR with 17.1-month median PFS.

news.headline: Caribou's single-dose CAR-T shows 92% response in 12 myeloma patients
news.summary: Deeper dive into the CaMMouflage Phase 1 dose-escalation update: at the 450 million cell dose, all 12 BCMA-naive relapsed/refractory myeloma patients responded, with 83% achieving a complete or stringent complete response and 91% MRD-negativity. This dose is now being carried into the ongoing dose-expansion cohort.

news.headline: Allogeneic CAR-T company prepares to widen access to patients
news.summary: Feature piece on Caribou's off-the-shelf manufacturing strategy for vispa-cel and CB-011, framing the company's chRDNA genome-editing platform and TRAC knockout approach as key to scaling allogeneic CAR-T beyond the reach of autologous therapies. Ties the manufacturing narrative to the upcoming ANTLER-3 pivotal trial.

news.headline: Caribou Biosciences shares rise on technical buy signal
news.summary: CRBU triggered a technical buy signal from a pivot-bottom point on July 31, 2026 and rallied over 13% in the following sessions, part of a broader run that left the stock up roughly 58% over the trailing 52 weeks heading into the Q2 print.

catalysts.label: Initial CaMMouflage (CB-011) dose-expansion data
catalysts.detail: Following the strong dose-escalation update at the 450M-cell dose (92% ORR, 91% MRD-negativity), Caribou guided to initial dose-expansion data in both BCMA-naive and BCMA-exposed relapsed/refractory myeloma patients in H2 2026. This is the next major readout the stock is watching.

catalysts.label: Pivotal trial funding / partnership decision
catalysts.detail: Caribou continues to evaluate equity, business-development deals, structured financings and other non-dilutive options to fully fund the ~250-patient ANTLER-3 pivotal trial for vispa-cel. Management calls securing a clear line of sight to funding mission-critical before dosing the first pivotal patient.

catalysts.label: vispa-cel ANTLER-3 pivotal Phase 3 start
catalysts.detail: FDA alignment on the randomized, ~250-patient Phase 3 design in CD19-naive, transplant/autologous-CAR-T-ineligible 2L LBCL is secured. Initiation remains contingent on closing the financing gap flagged above.

catalysts.label: Cash runway limit
catalysts.detail: Cash, equivalents and marketable securities of $113.8M (as of June 30, 2026) are now guided to fund the current operating plan, including CB-011 dose expansion and vispa-cel pivotal start-up activities, into the end of 2027 -- extended slightly from the prior 2H 2027 guide after cost cuts. A financing or partnership before then remains the key overhang.

catalysts.label: Next investor conference appearances
catalysts.detail: Management has historically used fall healthcare conferences (Citi, Morgan Stanley, H.C. Wainwright) to update investors on financing progress for the pivotal program; no confirmed September dates were disclosed as of this update.

pulse: Q2 2026 results (reported Aug 13) were a mixed but net-positive print: deeper myeloma data at the 450M-cell CB-011 dose (92% ORR, 91% MRD-negativity) and continued strength in vispa-cel's 2L LBCL dataset (82% ORR, 17.1-month PFS) reaffirm that Caribou's off-the-shelf CRISPR CAR-T platform can compete with autologous therapies, and cost discipline pushed the cash runway out slightly to the end of 2027. But Bank of America's target cut to $5 (from $6) right after the print shows the Street still discounting the stock hard for financing risk -- the ~250-patient ANTLER-3 pivotal trial cannot start until Caribou closes a funding gap via equity, partnership or structured financing, and that overhang, not the science, is what is capping the shares near $1.5-1.7. Watch for H2 2026 CaMMouflage dose-expansion data and any concrete financing/partnership announcement as the next catalysts that could re-rate the stock in either direction.
